digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure - subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Five subprocess reap tests each burn ~1s wall-clock waiting for a 1s timeout deadline to expire, creating load-dependent flakes on slow hosts.

Three reap tests depend on child-side setup (pidfile creation, spawn counter, stdout flush) completing before timeout fires, which is only guaranteed by accident if the timeout window exceeds interpreter startup time.

The blanket autouse fixture setting REBAR_ACLI_TIMEOUT=1 creates a latent load flake in the opposite direction for test_run_acli_429_retries_with_rate_limit_backoff, whose two child processes must complete within 1s.
The tight_stall fixture injects a 2s low-speed window for git throughput tests, but a sibling test already demonstrates git honors 1s windows.
Child-side setup races must be eliminated by explicit readiness gates (marker files and polling) rather than tuned by picking larger timeout values.
